review: The parent commit d4a2ccd9b364b526db7922e9533071ae1dcc9326 is titled Revert zygisk changes but also moves system_properties from 049ceb679 to 14b35941. That path belongs to resetprop compatibility, not only Zygisk.

At 14b35941, Update takes a special ro. branch that writes length bits without advancing the low serial counter, then returns before the property/global futex notification path. The archived R65A24840 notes explicitly advertise the read-only property behavior.

The official v31.0 pin 2bf706b2 uses a different sequence: update and wake, including appcompat override contexts, then restore the previous low serial counter. Similar final serial values do not prove equivalent waiter/global-counter behavior.

PR15 must compare short/long read-only values, mutable properties, property waiters, global counters and override contexts before accepting this historical row. No runtime parity is inferred from a matching name.
